rationale: The Latin anchors *intumescere* ("to swell up") and *tumida æquora* ("swollen/swelling seas") point to a physical, intransitive sense of swelling or becoming inflated, as confirmed by the Ps. Th. 106, 25 attestation referencing seas. The synset balloon.v.02 ("become inflated") matches this intransitive, literal physical sense of swelling, whereas inflate.v.02 is transitive (filling something with gas), making balloon.v.02 the better fit for Old English *a-þindan*.
